The '''SoroSuub government''' was the governing body of [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. This brief authoritarian takeover by the [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]] was a change from the democratic society experienced before.
In an attempt to increase support for themselves, the SoroSuub government provided the [[Aril Nunb]] as [[Executive officer/Legends|Executive officer]] of [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] in [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]].
